> **STOP — DO NOT SUBMIT THIS FORM AS A PUBLIC ISSUE.**
>
> Publicly disclosing an unpatched security vulnerability puts users and deployments at risk.

## How to Report a Security Vulnerability Privately

1. **GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting (Preferred):**
   Submit a confidential report directly via:
   https://github.com/SubhransuNayak007/muxaro/security/advisories/new

2. **Security Policy:**
   Review full disclosure timelines, scope, and safe-harbor guidelines in [`SECURITY.md`](../../SECURITY.md).

## What to Include in Your Private Advisory
- Affected component (`apps/api`, `apps/media-worker`, `apps/web`, `security`, `packages/*`, `infra`)
- Vulnerability class (e.g., SSRF, command injection, auth bypass, quota race, XSS, secret exposure)
- Step-by-step reproduction instructions or minimal proof-of-concept
- Potential impact and any suggested remediation

Thank you for helping keep MUXARO and its users safe.
